description: This file defines the default theme for CKEditor, including functions to build theme spaces, dialogs, and resize the editor interface.

methods.name: b
methods.description: Creates and manages shared spaces within the CKEditor theme, handling focus and destruction events.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the theme layout including top, content, and bottom spaces, and sets up event handlers.

methods.name: buildDialog
methods.description: Constructs dialog UI elements for the theme.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Removes theme elements and cleans up resources.
